title: Fall Seed Swap
summary: Bring saved seed, take saved seed. Labels, envelopes and coffee provided.
body:
Our biggest swap of the year, with tables for vegetables, flowers, herbs and natives. Bring seed in labelled envelopes if you have it, or just come and take some home.

Volunteers will run a short seed-saving demo at 11 am and again at 1 pm.

title: Winterizing Your Plot
summary: Cover crops, mulch and what to do with the tomato cages. A members-only webinar.
body:
A practical session on putting beds to rest: when to sow cover crops, how much mulch is enough and what to compost.

The recording goes into the member resource library the next day.

title: Lot to Garden: Legal Clinic
summary: Volunteer lawyers explain leases, land trusts and how to protect a garden on borrowed land.
body:
Bring your questions about vacant lots, city leases and land trusts. Volunteer attorneys answer general questions; this is not legal advice for your case.

Join in person or online.

title: Water-Wise Growing in the Desert
summary: Drip irrigation, shade cloth and the vegetables that love October in Phoenix.
body: A hands-on morning building a drip line and a shade frame. Gloves and tools provided; bring water.

title: Tool Library Repair Day
summary: Sharpen, oil and fix the tools that got us through the season.
body: Bring a broken tool or help fix the library's. Sharpening stations, handle replacement and lunch.

title: Grant Writing for Garden Groups
summary: How to write a strong application for a Commonground seed grant, with real examples.
body: We walk through two funded applications line by line and share the reviewers' checklist.

title: Hoop Houses on a Budget
summary: Build a 10 by 20 foot hoop house for under $400. We build one together.
body: A build day: we assemble a hoop house from start to finish and send everyone home with the plans.

title: Commonground Gathering 2027
summary: Three days of workshops, garden tours and the annual members' meeting. Members pay less.
body:
Our annual conference: 40 workshops, tours of eleven Pittsburgh gardens and the annual members' meeting, where members vote on the board.

Member rate $120, non-member $190. Sessions are streamed for members who cannot travel.

title: Summer Harvest Potluck
summary: Our end-of-summer potluck. Bring a dish made with something you grew.
body: Thank you to the 140 neighbours who came.
